async def act(page):
    # Open the author filter dropdown if not already open
    author_button = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Author')
    if await author_button.get_attribute('aria-expanded') == 'false':
        await author_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    # Select Kilian from the dropdown
    kilian_option = page.get_by_role('option', name='Kilian', exact=True)
    if await kilian_option.count() > 0:
        await kilian_option.click()
    else:
        # If Kilian not found as option, try other roles
        kilian_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Kilian', exact=True)
        if await kilian_link.count() > 0:
            await kilian_link.click()
        else:
            kilian_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Kilian', exact=True)
            if await kilian_button.count() > 0:
                await kilian_button.click()
            else:
                print("Kilian not found in author filter.")
                return
    # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get all commit links in the main section
    commit_links = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('link')
    count = await commit_links.count()
    if count == 0:
        # Check for 'No commits' message
        no_commits = page.get_by_text('No commits')
        if await no_commits.count() > 0:
            print("No commits found for Kilian.")
        else:
            print("No commit links found.")
    else:
        # Output the text content of each commit link for inspection
        for i in range(count):
            link = commit_links.nth(i)
            text = await link.text_content()
            print(text)
    return
